# SEC-002: Platform main .env is not world readable

- **Group:** Secrets on disk
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

The panel's own .env holds its app key, database and Redis passwords; with the app key an attacker can decrypt every stored server key and secret. It must not be world readable. It is mounted into the panel container, so plain 600 with the wrong owner can stop the panel from starting: keep the owner and group the platform set up.

## Verify by hand

```sh
stat -c '%a %U:%G' /data/coolify/source/.env
```

## How to fix it

chmod o-rwx /data/coolify/source/.env and keep the owner and group the installer set (the documented install uses 9999:root and chmod 700).

## What a fix can break

Changing the owner or making it 600 for another user can stop the panel from reading its config.
